classification.difficultyReason: Calculate compound depreciation over five years and compare the estimated value with the actual sale price.

content.prompt: A school bought a bus for $\$90\,000$, depreciated it at $30\%$ p.a., and sold it again five years later for $\$20\,000$. Was the price that they obtained better or worse than the depreciated value, and by how much? Give your answer to the nearest dollar.

answer.short:
Better by $\$4874$, to the nearest dollar.

The depreciated value is $\$15\,126.30$.
answer.worked:
Using $A_n=P(1-R)^n$:

$$\begin{align*}A_5&=90\,000(1-0.30)^5\\A_5&=90\,000(0.70)^5\\A_5&=\$15\,126.30\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\text{Difference}&=20\,000-15\,126.30\\\text{Difference}&=\$4873.70\end{align*}$$

The sale price was better than the depreciated value by $\$4874$, to the nearest dollar.
